definitions.name: FreshBooks Get Identity (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /auth/api/v1/users/me. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. definitions.name: FreshBooks Get Client (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/users/clients/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks List clients (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/users/clients. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Create Client (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks POST /accounting/account/:accountId/users/clients. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Update Client (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks PUT /accounting/account/:accountId/users/clients/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Get Invoice (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/invoices/invoices/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks List invoices (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/invoices/invoices. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Create Invoice (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks POST /accounting/account/:accountId/invoices/invoices. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Update Invoice (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks PUT /accounting/account/:accountId/invoices/invoices/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: FreshBooks Get Estimate (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/estimates/estimates/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks List estimates (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/estimates/estimates. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Create Estimate (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks POST /accounting/account/:accountId/estimates/estimates. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. definitions.name: FreshBooks Update Estimate (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks PUT /accounting/account/:accountId/estimates/estimates/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Get Expense (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/expenses/expenses/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks List expenses (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/expenses/expenses. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Create Expense (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks POST /accounting/account/:accountId/expenses/expenses. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Update Expense (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks PUT /accounting/account/:accountId/expenses/expenses/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Get Payment (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/payments/payments/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks List payments (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/payments/payments. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Create Payment (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks POST /accounting/account/:accountId/payments/payments. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Update Payment (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks PUT /accounting/account/:accountId/payments/payments/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Create Item (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks POST /accounting/account/:accountId/items/items. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Update Item (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks PUT /accounting/account/:accountId/items/items/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Mark Invoice Sent (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks PUT /accounting/account/:accountId/invoices/invoices/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: FreshBooks Get Project (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /projects/business/:businessId/project/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. definitions.name: FreshBooks Create Project (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks POST /projects/business/:businessId/project. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Update Project (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks PUT /projects/business/:businessId/project/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Get TimeEntry (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /timetracking/business/:businessId/time_entries/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks List time_entries (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /timetracking/business/:businessId/time_entries. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Create TimeEntry (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks POST /timetracking/business/:businessId/time_entries. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Update TimeEntry (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks PUT /timetracking/business/:businessId/time_entries/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks Get Service (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /comments/business/:businessId/service/:id. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. Official sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start https://www.freshbooks.com/api/identity_model https://www.freshbooks.com/api/clients https://www.freshbooks.com/api/invoices https://www.freshbooks.com/api/estimates https://www.freshbooks.com/api/expenses https://www.freshbooks.com/api/payments https://www.freshbooks.com/api/items https://www.freshbooks.com/api/project https://www.freshbooks.com/api/services https://www.freshbooks.com/api/time_entries https://www.freshbooks.com/api/parameters https://www.freshbooks.com/api/reports https://www.freshbooks.com/api/auth https://www.freshbooks.com/api/scopes

definitions.name: FreshBooks List services (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /comments/business/:businessId/services. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Create Service (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks POST /comments/business/:businessId/service. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Get Service Rate (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /comments/business/:businessId/service/:id/rate. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks POST /comments/business/:businessId/service/:id/rate. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Update Service Rate (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks PUT /comments/business/:businessId/service/:id/rate. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites.
