definitions.name: FreshBooks Report payments_collected (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/reports/accounting/payments_collected. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Report taxsummary (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/account/:accountId/reports/accounting/taxsummary. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Report trial_balance (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One bounded FreshBooks GET /accounting/businesses/:businessUuid/reports/trial_balance. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites. definitions.name: FreshBooks Invoice Changed (Relay) Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by FreshBooks Invoice Changed (Relay).
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for FreshBooks Invoice Changed (Relay). This trigger accepts the canonical version-1 freshbooks envelope only; it does not authenticate or decode native provider requests. Required exact provider verification: Complete the FreshBooks POST verifier/callback PUT handshake outside ONF; retain verifier securely. Verify X-FreshBooks-Hmac-SHA256 using the documented canonical JSON-of-string-form-values algorithm and base64 output, not raw-body hexadecimal HMAC. Mapping: Parse form-urlencoded parameters after signature verification. Map name/object_id/account_id/business_id/identity_id; use a durable relay-assigned delivery ID and observation time because provider callbacks lack a universal event identifier/timestamp. Do not emit verifier-handshake requests. Canonical eventType values: invoice.create, invoice.update, invoice.delete. Required envelope: version=1, provider=freshbooks, deliveryId, eventType, occurredAt (UTC ISO milliseconds), accountId, resource as the typed output schema. Omit no required fields; use explicit null where allowed. Filters accountId/resourceId are exact matches; blank disables a filter. At most 100 account+delivery IDs within 96 KiB deduplicate retries per group; state commits on trigger success before downstream completion. FreshBooks callback signature canonicalization differs from generic raw-body HMAC. Notification delivery may be delayed; no automatic resource fetch or invoice/payment mutation occurs. Sources: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/webhooks

ingressRequirements.name: FreshBooks business callbacks relay
ingressRequirements.description: Manual prerequisite: separately maintained exact provider authentication/normalization relay. This release only accepts header-authenticated canonical envelopes from that relay.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Complete the FreshBooks POST verifier/callback PUT handshake outside ONF; retain verifier securely. Verify X-FreshBooks-Hmac-SHA256 using the documented canonical JSON-of-string-form-values algorithm and base64 output, not raw-body hexadecimal HMAC.

Parse form-urlencoded parameters after signature verification. Map name/object_id/account_id/business_id/identity_id; use a durable relay-assigned delivery ID and observation time because provider callbacks lack a universal event identifier/timestamp. Do not emit verifier-handshake requests.

Implement the exact canonical version-1 envelope and typed resource schemas documented by each selected trigger; forward one event per POST. Normalize account identity from the authorized provider connection, never from an untrusted request.

Persist one stable delivery ID per logical event across relay retries. Fanout IDs must include distinct native entity/event/status identity (or a persisted record ID); reusing a batch delivery ID or message ID across different statuses drops events. Authorize account/resources; bound payloads to 64 KiB and limit rate.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-events"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.

network.purpose: Provider HTTPS callbacks reach the independently deployed relay; ONF uses its existing HTTPS publication.
